structure: Frame the situation: dinner is at six, it's five to six, and the guests are already arriving.
Most serious prediction: the overflowing bucket and the puddle creeping toward the power strip.
Further predictions: the man on the phone, the smoking oven and alarm, the cat and the vase.
Realistic outcome with hedging (my guess is…, it's unlikely that…).
modelAnswer: Judging by this picture, this couple's dinner party is going to get off to a rocky start. According to the sticky note, dinner is at six, the clock says five to six, and through the window you can see two guests already coming up the path with a gift and a bottle. Meanwhile, water is dripping from a stain on the ceiling into a bucket that's already filled to the brim, so it's bound to overflow, and the puddle beside it is creeping toward a power strip on the floor. If the water reaches it, the lamp could short out, so I'd expect someone to unplug it. The man standing near the leak is on the phone, presumably to the building manager, but it's unlikely anyone will come and fix it tonight. On top of that, smoke is pouring out of the oven, so the smoke alarm will probably go off, and the cat on the counter is pawing at a vase of flowers. My guess is that dinner will be ruined and they'll end up ordering takeout.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Khởi đầu không suôn sẻ — thành ngữ tự nhiên cho dự đoán tổng quát
Chắc chắn sẽ tràn — 'be bound to' diễn tả sự chắc chắn cao
Đang lan dần về phía… — mô tả manh mối đang tiến triển
Có lẽ là… — suy đoán lịch sự khi không chắc chắn
Khó có khả năng… — dự đoán phủ định với mức chắc chắn thấp

usefulExpressions.expression: My guess is that… will end up…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Tôi đoán rốt cuộc… — kết luận kết cục hợp lý

commonMistakes: Liệt kê mọi chi tiết mà không ưu tiên; hãy nói việc nguy hiểm nhất trước (nước gần ổ điện) rồi mới đến con mèo.
Dùng 'will' cho mọi câu; ở band 9 cần đa dạng mức độ chắc chắn: 'is bound to', 'I'd expect', 'presumably', 'it's unlikely'.
Khẳng định điều tranh không cho thấy (ví dụ 'he is calling the plumber'); hãy dùng 'presumably' hoặc 'probably'.
